zscore_fit: global mean and population standard deviation of each channel's tuning-only query-gallery score matrix
split_policy: image-disjoint tuning and holdout galleries; no changing variants or parameters after seeing replay results
old_dataset_policy: The 240-image dataset is already observed and every new result on it is exploratory, never a fresh confirmation.
threshold_limit: Known-pair target retention and candidate counts only. Other images are not exhaustively judged. Never label these diagnostics no-relevant precision or false-positive rates.
cost_policy: Mean-vector needs two image encodings but one stored vector; max needs two vectors. Cross-model fusion requires two text encoders and separate vector spaces/indexes. CPU replay does not measure end-to-end product latency.

confirmation_dataset.exclusion: exclude old dataset image IDs and content SHA256; split by image
